story.title: Bellow and Zach Train
story.blurb: Zach teaches Bellow swordfighting with sticks on a forest planet, and the lessons slowly turn into quiet talks about home, old crews and what happened on Barbona.

lines.text: The Hori- sorry, Goblinators are parked in some random forest planet, presumably for supplies that they keep running out of. And while everyone is out shopping, Zach hangs back and walks the forest, picking up and examining various sticks on the ground.

lines.text: Bellow had finished shopping when he received a text from Zach.
“Meet me outside the ship in two hours.” Bellow looks at the text confused, but he’ll entertain it.

lines.text: The next time Bellow gets a text from Zach, Zach says to meet him when it’s dark. An odd request, but he pays no mind to it.
It’s dark when Bellow turns the corner and sees Zach sat crisscrossed near a campfire.
“What’s this? I thought we were training…”

lines.text: “We are training. Part of being a swordsman is keeping a clear head in battle at all times. So this lesson we’ll be meditating. And also just… talking.”

lines.text: They continue this for several days, Bellow is getting faster and even managing to get a few hits in. Zach is proud of Bellow’s progress, but as the days go by Zach keeps remembering what happened on Barbona. It’s distracting him and he takes a nasty swing to the face.

“Oh my God Zach! Are you ok?” Bellow shouts, dropping his stick and grabbing Zach’s arm and directing him to sit down, leaning against the ship. “Let’s sit down, and I should have some stuff on hand. Oh God…I’m so sorry!” Bellow started pulling out various medical supplies, starting with disinfectant wipes and rubbing at the cut.
